description: This file defines a static class 'StableHash' that provides methods to compute hash digests for byte arrays and strings, utilizing the XxHash32 algorithm and handling endianness.

classes.name: StableHash
classes.description: A static utility class for computing hash digests of data using the XxHash32 algorithm, with support for endianness handling.

methods.name: ComputeHash (ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
methods.description: Computes a hash digest for a span of bytes using the XxHash32 algorithm, with endianness correction.

methods.name: ComputeHash (string data)
methods.description: Computes a hash digest for a string, converting it to bytes with appropriate encoding based on system endianness.
